title: Invariant Earth MCP Server for GIS and Property Data
heading: Invariant Earth MCP server
description: Connect an AI agent to U.S. parcel, flood and infrastructure data. Look up addresses, screen sites and review the records behind each result.
signIn: Sign in through your MCP client or keep your Invariant API key in its secret storage.

tools.name: invariant_geocode
tools.title: Resolve an address
tools.description: Normalize a U.S. address and check the quality of the location match.

tools.name: invariant_enrich
tools.title: Look up a parcel
tools.description: Check the parcel match and request the boundary and supported fields.

tools.name: invariant_fetch
tools.title: Screen a location
tools.description: Look up a point’s flood zone, elevation, and nearby infrastructure where available.

tools.name: invariant_proximity
tools.title: Check driving access
tools.description: Calculate a route, travel time, or drive area from a location.

trial.heading: Test the connection with a known parcel
trial.question: Which parcel matches 100 Larkin Street in San Francisco? Keep the leading zero. Show the address match, parcel ID, boundary source, and retrieval date where available.
trial.evidence: In the dated reference data, the city address point falls inside San Francisco parcel 0354001. Compare the returned match and geometry with the reference before using the result.
